## Explanatory Data Analysis

This is the explanatory data section. In this section we will look at the explore the images.

```{r}
data <- handwriting
dim(data$images) # 25000 x 28 x 28 x 1
head(data$metadata)
names(data)

```

```{r}
unique(data$metadata$person_id)
unique(data$metadata$digit)
unique(data$metadata$session)
```

```{r}
display_image <- function(image, title = "") {
  
  if (length(dim(image)) == 3) {
    image <- image[, , 1]
  }
  
  image(
    t(apply(image, 2, rev)),
    col = gray.colors(256),
    axes = FALSE,
    main = title
  )
}
```

```{r}
display_image(
  data$images[1,,,],
  "First image"
)
```

```{r}
people_examples <- data$metadata %>%
  filter(
    digit == 0,
    session == 1
  ) %>%
  group_by(person_id) %>%
  slice_sample(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
people_examples
```

```{r}
par(
  mfrow = c(4, 5),
  mar = c(1, 1, 2, 1)
)

for (i in 1:nrow(people_examples)) {
  
  image_id <- people_examples$image_id[i]
  person <- people_examples$person_id[i]
  
  display_image(
    data$images[image_id,,,],
    paste("Person", person)
  )
}

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```
